title: Exterior Car Detailing in the Cowichan Valley: What's Actually Included
metaDescription: See exactly what's included in Ashton's Exterior Detail package, from $89, and why Cowichan Valley driving conditions make it worth booking regularly.
excerpt: A drive-through car wash and a proper exterior detail aren't the same thing. Here's what's actually included in Ashton's Exterior Detail package and why it matters on Vancouver Island roads.

content.text: A lot of customers book their first appointment thinking an exterior detail is just a fancier car wash. It isn't. A car wash moves surface dirt off the paint. An exterior detail removes what's actually bonded to it, then protects the surface so grime has a harder time sticking next time. On Vancouver Island, where cars deal with gravel roads, salt air off the Cowichan Bay and Maple Bay waterfronts, and sap from the fir and arbutus trees that line most Cowichan Valley driveways, that difference shows up fast.
What's included in Ashton's Exterior Detail (from $89)

items: Hand wash using the two-bucket method, not a brush tunnel that can swirl your paint
Wheel and rim cleaning to strip embedded brake dust, plus tire dressing with UV protection
Door jambs, fuel door, and trunk seal wiped down — the spots most car washes skip entirely
Paint decontamination to lift bonded contaminants like tree sap, tar, and rail dust that washing alone won't remove
Exterior glass cleaned streak-free, inside and out where accessible
A coat of paint protection sealant applied to the whole exterior to add shine and water repellency

content.text: Why this matters more here than in a typical city

Duncan, Cobble Hill, Mill Bay, and Shawnigan Lake all have a mix of paved and gravel side roads, and gravel dust is abrasive — it sits in your clear coat and dulls it over time if it's never properly lifted off. Add in fir sap that drips onto vehicles parked under trees in Crofton, Chemainus, or Lake Cowichan, and you've got contaminants that a standard wash won't touch. Left alone, sap etches into clear coat and becomes a permanent blemish. A decontamination pass gets it off before that happens.
Exterior only, or the Full Detail?

If your interior still looks decent and the issue is dull, contaminated, or grimy paint and wheels, the Exterior Detail on its own is the right call and the better value.
